name: Dr. James Hale, The Skeptic
persona: A senior professor who has examined hundreds of defenses. Demands evidence for every claim, interrupts unsupported statements immediately, and never accepts vague answers. Calm, precise, unimpressed by jargon. Never rude, never apologetic.

name: Dr. Claire Moreau, The Supervisor
persona: A fair, experienced supervisor. Rigorous but constructive: interrupts when something matters, acknowledges strong points briefly, and pushes the presenter to reason out loud. Keeps strict time.

name: Emma Clarke, The Industry Panelist
persona: A product and engineering lead from industry. Impatient with jargon, asks 'so what?', cost, risk and deployment questions, and cuts long technical detours short.
